title: Location Management History — the five price-book columns record no price-book name ('USD: ; CAD: ; MXN:'), so the audit trail cannot show which price book was set
requirementSource: NM-3937 'Representative Location Management History fields' — Pricing: Labor Corporate Price Book History, Non-Labor Corporate Price Book History, Labor Production Price Book History, Price Book Name; AC4 'Required representative headers and values render correctly'. NM-820 defines the Location Management History columns.
stepsToReproduce: Open https://cloudapps-e2e.encoreglobal.com/navigator/locations/1604/settings/location, open the Pricing sub-tab, and note the USD price books (Primary Labor Pricing '2026-Zone 3 D', Primary Equipment Pricing '2026-Tier 2 Resort B', Internal Equipment '2023-Internal2', Production Labor '2026-NP LB3', Production Equipment '2026-NP Tier 2').
Click the Location Management History tab and wait for the grid.
Scroll to the columns Labor Pricing, Equip. Pricing, Internal Equip. Pricing, Production Labor Pricing, Production Equip. Pricing and read any row.
expectedBehavior: Each price-book column shows the price book in effect per currency, e.g. 'USD: 2026-Zone 3 D' — as the old site's Location Management History does for the same office.
actualBehavior: Every row shows 'USD: ; CAD: ; MXN:' with no price-book name. The history API returns the price-book IDs (defaultLaborCorporatePriceBookId etc. populated) but every *Name field empty: 0 of the 200 most recent history records for office 1604 carry any price-book name. A price-book change is therefore invisible in the audit trail.

mcpEvidence.findings: Grid top 3 rows: Labor Pricing = Equip. Pricing = 'USD: ; CAD: ; MXN:'. POST /navigator/api/location/get-location-setting-history (pageSize 200): pricing.corporatePricingSettings[USD] = { defaultLaborCorporatePriceBookId: 'fb39fe02-…', defaultNonLaborCorporatePriceBookId: '65e9b37f-…', defaultProductionLaborPbId: '87db1715-…', … , defaultLaborCorporatePriceBookName: '', defaultNonLaborCorporatePriceBookName: '', defaultLaborInternalPriceBookName: '', defaultNonLaborInternalPriceBookName: '', defaultProductionLaborPbName: '', defaultProductionNonLaborPbName: '' }; rowsWithAnyName = 0 of 200. Pricing sub-tab at the same time: location-settings-select-primary-labor-pricing-usd = '2026-Zone 3 D', -equipment- = '2026-Tier 2 Resort B', -internal-equipment- = '2023-Internal2', -production-labor- = '2026-NP LB3', -production-equipment- = '2026-NP Tier 2'.

networkEvidence: History response carries price-book IDs with empty name fields — the names are never resolved, so the grid has nothing to render.
